correctness.rationale: From iid geometric regeneration, the exact CLT variance is p² times a convergent centered static-walk moment series. Explicit path enumeration proves all first and second moments through four steps using only the first two site-bias moments. Substitution and a uniform O((1-p)^4) tail bound prove the cubic law and the weak-drift limit. An independent first-opposing-arrow decomposition yields the exact rational fair-arrow variance for every p>0. The bundled symbolic checker verifies all critical identities; no finite experiment is used as an infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The closest 2026 preprint proves the underlying regenerative series and the quadratic coefficient, but not the zero-drift cubic sign, uniform weak-drift crossover, or exact fair-arrow rational diffusivity. These require explicit new finite annealed moment identities and a global geometric two-cycle summation. Older deterministic cooling papers do not imply this geometric-refresh coefficient. Equivalence to an implicit older specialization remains the central risk.

value.rationale: The source identifies a strict variance minimum for nonzero drift but leaves the degenerate zero-drift case unresolved by its second derivative. The universal negative cubic term reverses the local extremum, the uniform drift scaling separates enhancement from suppression, and the exactly solvable fair-arrow law establishes a global and natural non-elliptic benchmark. This identifies transport structure beyond a routine restatement of the regenerative CLT.
